rationale: C25 is an almost clause-for-clause template for the child: both identify a railway carrier and represented employees, state that the dispute was not adjusted under the Railway Labor Act, invoke the National Mediation Board's judgment that interstate commerce and essential transportation service are threatened, require a report within thirty days, and impose the same statutory freeze on changes until thirty days after the report. The child primarily substitutes the disputing carrier, union, and geographic characterization. C08 and C10 use the same machinery and nearly identical language, but C25 is the strongest match because it is the most recent and shares the formulation that a broad portion of the country would be deprived of service.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Railway Express Agency, Inc., a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the International Brotherhood of Teamsters...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Terminal Railroad Association of St. Louis, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers...
shared_material.explanation: The opening clause follows the same party-identification template, with the carrier and labor representatives substituted.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended

shared_material.child_excerpt: in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a large section of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a large portion of the country of essential transportation service
shared_material.explanation: The distinctive statutory finding is nearly verbatim, differing only in 'section' versus 'portion.'

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Railway Express Agency, Inc., or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Terminal Railroad Association of St. Louis or its employees in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.
shared_material.explanation: The operative status-quo provision is copied almost exactly, with only the carrier name changed.
